notes.text: Translation and scaling through transform functions and individual properties, their browser-defined composition order, transform-list order, default and explicit origins, percentages, unchanged flow and offset geometry, descendant propagation, and transformed point queries have exact Chromium parity coverage.

Taffy computes untransformed layout; the adapter projects border rectangles and hit boxes through ancestor and local affine transforms after layout, matching the browser distinction between layout geometry and transformed client geometry.
Rotation, skew, matrix(), perspective, and 3D transform functions remain unsupported and route through the configured unsupported CSS policy.

Overflow clipping is computed before transforms, and transform-created stacking contexts and containing blocks are not modeled. These can differ from Chromium when a transformed descendant crosses an overflow clip, participates in stacking-context ordering, or uses absolute/fixed positioning relative to a transformed ancestor.
